### Lantern Pharma to Present at the ThinkEquity Conference in NYC on October 15th, 2026


October 8, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/479690122/files/doc_news/Lantern-Pharma-to-Present-at-the-ThinkEquity-Conference-in-NYC-on-October-15th-2026-2026.pdf)


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Lantern Pharma Inc. (NASDAQ: LTRN), an artificial intelligence (“AI”) company developing targeted and transformative cancer therapies using its proprietary RADR® AI and machine learning (“ML”) platform with multiple clinical stage drug programs, today announced that Lantern management will be presenting at the ThinkEquity Conference on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 3:30 p.m. ET at the Mandarin Oriental in New York, NY.


- Webcast Link:[https://event.summitcast.com/view/GXv6JAoMEphytK6ggozCk7/VS4pGMrvkgq2xwHrNQevWX](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FGXv6JAoMEphytK6ggozCk7%2FVS4pGMrvkgq2xwHrNQevWX&esheet=54618155&newsitemid=20261008156050&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FGXv6JAoMEphytK6ggozCk7%2FVS4pGMrvkgq2xwHrNQevWX&index=1&md5=2e0fec7a96fb37b1002bd390822a267d)
- Conference Registration Link:[https://www.meetmax.com/sched/event_138793/conference_register.html](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_138793%2Fconference_register.html&esheet=54618155&newsitemid=20261008156050&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meetmax.com%2Fsched%2Fevent_138793%2Fconference_register.html&index=2&md5=7e27767e4ff2a66e32b0c0c28fc19ad7)


Lantern Pharma management will be available for one-on-one meetings held throughout the conference.


**About Lantern Pharma**


Lantern Pharma Inc. (NASDAQ: LTRN) is a clinical-stage, AI-driven precision oncology company developing targeted therapies for high-need cancer indications. The Company’s proprietary RADR® AI platform integrates multi-omic biomarker data with clinical outcomes to identify patient subgroups most likely to respond to specific therapies, enabling more efficient clinical development and biomarker-driven trial design. Lantern’s pipeline includes LP-300 (HARMONIC™ trial in never-smoker NSCLC), LP-184, and LP-284, with additional preclinical programs identified through RADR®.
